paragraphs: TKO is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO's businesses include UFC, the world's premier mixed martial arts ("MMA") organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; Professional Bull Riders ("PBR"), the world's premier bull riding organization; and its joint venture Zuffa Boxing, a professional boxing promotion. Together, these properties reach more than 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

TKO was initially established through the combination of UFC and WWE in September 2023. The combination of these two businesses united two complementary sports and sports entertainment properties in a single company. We significantly expanded our portfolio on February 28, 2025, when we completed the Endeavor Asset Acquisition, pursuant to which we acquired the IMG business, including certain businesses operating under the IMG brand, On Location, and PBR (collectively, the "Acquired Businesses") from EGH and its subsidiaries. The transaction was valued at approximately $3.25 billion plus a $50 million purchase price adjustment (based on the volume-weighted average sales price of TKO's Class A common stock for the twenty-five trading days ending on October 23, 2024), and was satisfied through the issuance of 26.54 million common units of TKO OpCo and an equivalent number of corresponding shares of TKO Class B common stock to the EGH Parties. This acquisition expanded TKO's operational capabilities across the sports landscape. We combine premier intellectual property ownership (UFC, WWE, PBR) with extensive capabilities in media rights distribution (IMG) and premium hospitality experiences (On Location), allowing us to maximize value across our assets and provide premier services to global rights holders and strategic partners.

We believe TKO's businesses are well-positioned among sports, media and entertainment peers given our comprehensive portfolio of premium intellectual property, global media distribution capabilities, and experiential offerings. The addition of IMG, a global leader in sports, events, and media, and On Location, a premium experiential hospitality provider for marquee global events, significantly expands our engagement with our global fanbase. Finally, PBR provides us with additional live event programming and media content. In total, our combined portfolio allows us to engage fans across the entire sports ecosystem, from media consumption to premium live event experiences.

Our management team has deep expertise in sports, media, and live events. Ariel Emanuel serves as CEO and Executive Chair and Mark Shapiro serves as President and COO at TKO. They each have decades of experience founding, acquiring, and scaling sports and entertainment businesses, including UFC, which Endeavor acquired in 2016 and subsequently executed a strategy that drove substantial value creation for shareholders. TKO's leadership team brings deep institutional and operational knowledge to our business, and we believe their proven track record of performance positions us to successfully execute organic and inorganic growth opportunities at TKO. We view this as a key competitive advantage within the dynamic sports and entertainment landscape.

The Company monetizes its media and content properties through four principal activities: (i) Media rights, production, and content, (ii) Live events and hospitality, (iii) Partnerships and marketing and (iv) Consumer products licensing, which are covered in greater detail in the "Overview of Revenue Sources" section of this Annual Report. A summary of our principal activities is presented in the table below:

The popularity of our marquee companies makes us attractive to media distribution and corporate partners. Across our portfolio, we have agreements with leading distributors, including Paramount, Disney's ESPN, Netflix, Versant, the CW, Rogers Sportsnet, WBDSports, and DAZN, among others, enabling our content to reach audiences around the globe. We have partnerships and marketing agreements with a wide variety of leading brands including Meta, Ram Trucks, Anheuser-Busch, IBM, Procter & Gamble, Monster Energy, Cuervo, Total Wireless, Wingstop, Slim Jim, and others across multiple categories. Our track record building our properties is driven by the quality and quantity of our program offerings and the favorable demographic profile of our core and growing fanbases.

UFC, the world's premier professional MMA organization, produces more than 40 live events annually which are broadcast in over 170 countries and territories to over 950 million TV households. UFC is among the most popular sports organizations in the world, reaching a global audience through an increasing array of global broadcast license agreements and our owned FIGHT PASS streaming platform. The value of our content is demonstrated by our licensing arrangements with Paramount+ and other international broadcasters, and our increasing consumer engagement is evidenced by the overall follower growth and engagement across our social channels. As of December 31, 2025, UFC has more than 700 million fans who skew young and diverse, as well as approximately 350 million social media followers.

WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment, produces and distributes unique and creative content through various channels, including content rights agreements with distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, Versant, and the CW for its weekly programs, Raw, SmackDown and NXT, and Premium Live Events, monetization across social media outlets, live events, and licensing of various WWE themed consumer products. WWE has over 700 million fans and approximately 490 million social media followers, inclusive of talent pages. WWE counts more than 110 million YouTube subscribers, making it one of the most viewed YouTube channels globally, and its year-round programming is available in over one billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages.

The IMG business is a leading global sports marketing company, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers revenue, fanbase, and IP growth for more than 300 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the English Premier League, Major League Soccer, The R&A, Wimbledon, DP World Tour, ATP and WTA Tours, the National Football League, CONMEBOL, Euroleague Basketball, Saudi Pro League, as well as its owned channel Sport 24.

On Location is a premium experiential hospitality business, offering ticketing, curated guest experiences, live event production and travel management across sports and entertainment. On Location provides unrivaled access for corporate clients and fans looking for official, immersive experiences at marquee events, including the 2024, 2026 and 2028 Summer and Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA World Cup 26, Super Bowl, NCAA Final Four, WWE, UFC, and more.

PBR is the world's premier bull riding organization. Currently, there are more than 1,000 bull riders who compete in more than 200 events annually across the PBR Unleash The Beast tour, which features the top bull riders in the world; the PBR Pendleton Whisky

Velocity Tour; the PBR Touring Pro Division; and international circuits in Australia, Brazil, and Canada. In addition, bull riders compete in the PBR Team Series, currently comprising 10 teams, as well as in the PBR Challenger Series, with more than 50 annual events nationwide. PBR Teams League and Unleash The Beast events are broadcast on CBS Television Network, with Teams League events also airing on the CW Network, for a combined reach of over 40 million viewers each year. Fans can also stream Unleash the Beast on Paramount+ and access the Teams League via FOX Nation, further extending PBR's reach into the digital space.

We believe our companies are well positioned for the future of media. We have the flexibility to deliver our content across channels to meet our fans where they are consuming media. Our multichannel distribution model enables TKO to capitalize on increased competition for premium live sports rights and sports entertainment programming across digital and linear services. We license our media rights under long-term contracts to leading distributors globally. The contractual, recurring nature of our revenue base provides our business with good visibility into revenue growth, which supports further investment in our products and adjacent content reinforcing the value of our properties to our fans and partners.

We generate revenue from the licensing of our live events and original programming to domestic and international broadcasters and distributors that carry our programming on digital and linear channels and via pay-per-view ("PPV"). Original programming includes long and short-form content, reality series and other filmed entertainment. Through the acquisition of IMG as part of the Endeavor Asset Acquisition on February 28, 2025, we also generate revenue by acting as a global distributor of sports programming, negotiating and selling media rights on behalf of rights holders, and providing content production and distribution services across a broad range of sports and live events.

We depend on the continued services of executive management and other key employees. The loss or diminished performance of these individuals could adversely affect our business.
Changes in public and consumer tastes and preferences and industry trends could reduce demand for our content offerings and adversely affect our business.
Our business and operating results may be affected by the outcome of pending and future litigation, investigations, claims and other disputes.
The impact of global pandemics or other health crises could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Our key personnel, athletes and performers may be adversely impacted by immigration restrictions and related factors.

Unauthorized disclosure of sensitive or confidential customer information could harm our business and standing with our customers.
paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves substantial risks. You should carefully consider the following factors, together with all of the other information included in this Annual Report, including under the heading "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and the consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report before investing in our Class A common stock. Any of the risk factors we describe below could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. The market price of our Class A common stock could decline if one or more of these risks or uncertainties develop into actual events, causing you to lose all or part of your investment. We cannot assure you that any of the events discussed below will not occur. Please also see "Forward-Looking Statements" for more information.

Our ability to generate revenue from discretionary and corporate spending on events, such as corporate sponsorships and advertising, is subject to many factors, including many that are beyond our control, such as general macroeconomic conditions.

Our business depends on discretionary consumer and corporate spending. Many factors related to corporate spending and discretionary consumer spending, including economic conditions affecting disposable consumer income such as unemployment levels, fuel prices, interest rates, changes in tax rates, tax laws that impact companies or individuals, and inflation, can significantly impact our operating results. While consumer and corporate spending may decline at any time for reasons beyond our control, the risks associated with our businesses become more acute in periods of a slowing economy or recession, which may be accompanied by reductions in corporate sponsorships and advertising, decreases in attendance at live events, and decreases in consumer spending on merchandising, among other things. There can be no assurance that consumer and corporate spending will not be adversely impacted by economic and geopolitical conditions, or by any future deterioration in economic conditions, thereby possibly impacting our operating results and growth. A prolonged period of reduced consumer or corporate spending, such as those that occurred during the COVID-19 pandemic, could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

We depend on key relationships with television and cable networks, satellite providers, digital streaming partners and other distribution partners. Our failure to maintain, renew or replace key agreements could adversely affect our ability to distribute our media content, and/or other of our goods and services, which could adversely affect our operating results.

A key component of our success is our relationships with television and cable networks, satellite providers, digital streaming and other distribution partners. We are dependent on maintaining these existing relationships and expanding upon them so that we have a robust network with which we can work to arrange multimedia rights sales, including distribution of our events and media content. Our television programming for our events is distributed by television and cable networks, satellite providers, pay-per-view ("PPV"), digital

streaming, and other media. Because a large portion of our revenues are generated, directly and indirectly, from the distribution of our events, any failure to maintain or renew arrangements with distributors and platforms, the failure of distributors or platforms to continue to provide services to us, or the failure to enter into new distribution opportunities on terms favorable to us could adversely affect our business. We regularly engage in negotiations relating to substantial agreements covering the distribution of our content by carriers located in the United States and abroad. We have agreements with multiple PPV providers globally and distribute a portion of our events through PPV, including certain events that are sold exclusively through PPV. We have important relationships with (i) Paramount, as the exclusive distributor for all UFC Numbered Events and UFC Fight Nights throughout the U.S. and Latin America and as exclusive distributor of UFC Fight Nights in Australia, as well as the exclusive distributor of Zuffa Boxing throughout the U.S. and distributor of certain PBR programming, (ii) ESPN as the exclusive distributor for all WWE PLEs in the U.S., (iii) Netflix as the exclusive global home for RAW (and, as rights become available globally, distribution for all WWE content outside the U.S., including premium live events) and other WWE library content, (iv) USA Network as the exclusive distributor for SmackDown in the U.S., (v) The CW, which carries NXT on its cable network stations, and (vi) Peacock as the exclusive distributor of WWE Saturday Night's Main Event in the U.S. Our agreement with Netflix relating to WWE has an initial 10-year term, with an option for Netflix to extend for an additional 10 years and to opt out after the initial five years. Our failure to maintain the Netflix agreement, including through Netflix exercising its opt-out rights, could adversely affect our ability to distribute WWE content, which could adversely affect our operating results.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the information set forth in our audited consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report.

On February 28, 2025, TKO OpCo, a Delaware limited liability company, and TKO, a Delaware corporation (together with TKO OpCo, the "TKO Parties"), completed the Endeavor Asset Acquisition, acquiring the IMG business, including certain businesses operating under the IMG brand, On Location, and Professional Bull Riders ("PBR") (collectively, the "Acquired Businesses"), pursuant to a transaction agreement, dated as of October 23, 2024 (as amended, the "Endeavor Asset Acquisition Agreement"), by and among the TKO Parties, Endeavor OpCo, IMG Worldwide, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("IMG Worldwide" and, together with Endeavor OpCo, the "EGH Parties"), and Trans World International, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and subsidiary of EGH ("TWI").

The historical financial data discussed below reflects our historical results of operations and financial position inclusive of the historical results of operations and financial position of the Acquired Businesses which were acquired in a common control acquisition on February 28, 2025; refer to our Form 8-Ks filed on February 28, 2025 and May 8, 2025 for further details. The historical financial data included in the discussion below reflects our historical results of operations and financial position and relates to periods prior to the closing of the TKO Transactions.

This discussion contains forward-looking statements based upon management's current plans, expectations and beliefs that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various known and unknown factors, including those set forth under Part I, Item 1A. "Risk Factors" and in other sections of this Annual Report.

The following is a discussion and analysis of, and a comparison between, our results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. A discussion and analysis of, and a comparison between, our results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023 is set forth in Exhibit 99.1, titled, Item 7. "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" filed with our Current Report on Form 8-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on May 8, 2025.

TKO is a premium sports and entertainment company which operates leading combat sports and sports entertainment companies. The Company monetizes its brands through four principal activities: (i) Media rights, production and content, (ii) Live events and hospitality, (iii) Partnerships and marketing, and (iv) Consumer products licensing.

TKO was formed through the combination of Zuffa Parent, LLC (n/k/a TKO Operating Company, LLC) which owns and operates the Ultimate Fighting Championship ("UFC"), a preeminent combat sports brand, and World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc. (n/k/a World Wrestling Entertainment, LLC) ("WWE"), a renowned sports entertainment business (the "TKO Transactions"). The TKO Transactions unite two complementary sports and sports entertainment properties in a single company. For additional information regarding the terms of the TKO Transactions, see Note 4, Acquisition of WWE, to our audited consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report.

In connection with the Endeavor Asset Acquisition Agreement, the TKO Parties acquired the Acquired Businesses for total consideration of approximately $3.25 billion plus a $50 million purchase price adjustment (based on the volume-weighted average sales price of TKO Class A common stock for the twenty five trading days ending on October 23, 2024). The EGH Parties received approximately 26.54 million common units of TKO OpCo and subscribed for an equivalent number of corresponding shares of TKO's Class B common stock.

With respect to the historical financial data of the Acquired Businesses for the periods prior to the completion of the Endeavor Asset Acquisition, the historical financial data has been derived from the combined financial statements and accounting records of Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc. and were prepared on a standalone basis in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP") and may not be indicative of what they would have been had the Acquired Businesses been independent standalone companies, nor are they necessarily indicative of the Acquired Businesses' future financial data.

With respect to the historical combined balance sheets of the Company, they include Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.'s consolidated assets and liabilities that are specifically identifiable or otherwise attributable to the Acquired Businesses, including subsidiaries and/or joint ventures relating to the Acquired Businesses in which Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc. had a controlling financial interest. The assets, liabilities, revenue and expenses of the Acquired Businesses have been reflected in these combined financial statements on a historical cost basis, as included in the consolidated financial statements of Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc., using the historical accounting policies applied by Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc. Cash and cash equivalents held by EGH at the corporate level were not attributable to the Acquired Businesses for any of the periods presented due to Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc's centralized approach to cash management and the financing of its operations. Only cash amounts held by entities for which the Acquired Businesses have legal title are reflected in the combined balance sheets. Transfers of cash, both to and from Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.'s centralized cash management system, are reflected as a component of net parent investment in the combined balance sheets and as financing activities in the accompanying combined statements of cash flows for the recast periods prior to the TKO formation on September 12, 2023. Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.'s debt on a consolidated basis was not attributed to the Acquired Businesses for any of the periods presented because Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.'s borrowings are not the legal obligation of the Acquired Businesses.

With respect to the historical combined financial statements of the Company, they include all revenues and costs directly attributable to the Acquired Businesses and reflect allocations of certain Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.'s corporate, infrastructure and shared services expenses, including centralized research, legal, human resources, payroll, finance and accounting, employee benefits, real estate, insurance, information technology, telecommunications, treasury, and other expenses. Where possible, these charges were allocated based on direct usage, with the remainder allocated on a pro rata basis of headcount and gross profit, or other allocation methodologies that are considered to be a reasonable reflection of the utilization of services provided or the benefit received by the Acquired Businesses during the periods presented. The allocations may not, however, reflect the expense the Acquired Businesses would have incurred as standalone companies for the periods presented. These costs also may not be indicative of the expenses that the Acquired Businesses will incur in the future or would have incurred if the Acquired Businesses had obtained these services from a third party.

Accordingly, as discussed above, the historical financial data presented within this discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations includes the consolidated historical financial data of TKO and the Acquired Businesses for all periods presented.

As of December 31, 2025, we operated our business under three reportable segments, UFC, WWE and IMG. In addition, we also report results for the "Corporate and Other" group, which incurs revenue and expenses that are not allocated to the business segments. Refer to Note 19, Segment Information, within the audited consolidated financial statements included elsewhere within this Annual Report.

The UFC segment reflects the business operations of UFC. Revenue from our UFC segment principally consists of media rights fees associated with the distribution of its programming content; ticket sales and site fees associated with the business's global live events; partnerships and marketing; and consumer products licensing agreements of UFC-branded products.

paragraphs: TKO 是一家高階運動與娛樂公司。TKO 的業務包括 UFC，全球首屈一指的混合格鬥運動（"MMA"）組織；WWE，全球運動娛樂領導者；專業牛仔騎士（"PBR"），全球首屈一指的牛仔騎馬組織；以及其合資公司 Zuffa Boxing，專業拳擊推廣。這些資產共同觸及超過 10 億個家庭，遍及 210 個國家與地區，並全年舉辦超過 500 場現場活動，吸引超過 300 萬名粉絲。TKO 還與主要運動版權持有者合作，透過 IMG，一家行業領先的全球運動行銷機構；以及 On Location，一家全球領先的高階體驗式豪華住宿服務機構。

TKO 最初於 2023 年 9 月透過 UFC 與 WWE 的合併成立。這兩家業務的合併，將兩個補充性的運動與運動娛樂資產整合於一家公司。我們於 2025 年 2 月 28 日大幅擴充資產組合，完成 Endeavor 資產收購，根據此交易，我們從 EGH 及其子公司取得 IMG 商業，包括部分以 IMG 品牌運作的業務、On Location 及 PBR（合稱為 "收購業務"）。交易價值約為 32.5 億美元加上 5,000 萬美元的購股調整金（基於 TKO 的 A 級普通股在 2024 年 10 月 23 日前 25 個交易日的體積加權平均銷售價格計算），並透過發行 2,654 萬股 TKO OpCo 普通單位及相等數量的 TKO B 級普通股給 EGH 方進行。此收購擴展了 TKO 在運動領域的運營能力。我們將首屈一指的智慧財產權擁有權（UFC、WWE、PBR）與廣泛的媒體版權發行能力（IMG）及高階豪華住宿體驗（On Location）結合，使我們能最大化資產價值，並為全球版權持有者與戰略夥伴提供首屈一指的服務。

我們認為 TKO 的業務在運動、媒體與娛樂業者中處於優勢地位，基於我們擁有完整的高階智慧財產權組合、全球媒體發行能力及體驗式服務。IMG 的加入，作為全球運動、活動與媒體的領導者，以及 On Location，作為高階體驗式豪華住宿服務機構，為標誌性全球活動提供服務，顯著擴展了我們與全球粉絲羣的互動。最後，PBR 為我們提供額外的現場活動節目與媒體內容。總體而言，我們的組合資產使我們能與粉絲羣在整個運動生態系中互動，從媒體消費到高階現場活動體驗。

我們的管理團隊在運動、媒體與現場活動方面擁有深厚的專業知識。Ariel Emanuel 擔任 CEO 與執行主席，Mark Shapiro 擔任 President 與 COO。他們各自擁有數十年的經驗，從事創辦、收購與擴張運動與娛樂業務，包括 UFC，Endeavor 於 2016 年收購 UFC，並執行了一項策略，為股東創造了顯著價值。TKO 的領導團隊為我們的業務帶來深厚的機構與運營知識，我們認為他們的績效紀錄使我們能成功執行 TKO 的內生與外生成長機會。我們視此為在動態運動與娛樂領域中的關鍵競爭優勢。
本公司透過四大主要活動來 monetize 其媒體與內容資產：(i) 媒體版權、製作與內容，(ii) 現場活動與豪華住宿，(iii) 合作夥伴與行銷，(iv) 消費者產品授權，這些內容在本年度報告的 "收入來源概覽" 節有更詳細說明。以下表格簡要說明我們的主要活動：

我們標誌性的公司因其受歡迎程度而吸引媒體發行與企業合作夥伴。在我們的資產組閤中，我們與領先的發行商有協議，包括 Paramount、Disney 的 ESPN、Netflix、Versant、CW、Rogers Sportsnet、WBDSports 及 DAZN 等，使我們的內容能觸及全球觀眾。我們與多種類別的領先品牌有合作與行銷協議，包括 Meta、Ram Trucks、Anheuser-Busch、IBM、Procter & Gamble、Monster Energy、Cuervo、Total Wireless、Wingstop、Slim Jim 等。我們的資產組建紀錄由我們的節目內容品質與數量以及我們核心與成長粉絲羣的有利人口統計資料所驅動。

UFC，全球首屈一指的專業 MMA 組織，每年舉辦超過 40 場現場活動，這些活動透過超過 170 個國家與地區的廣播，觸及超過 9.5 億個電視家庭。UFC 是全球最受歡迎的運動組織之一，透過不斷增加的全球廣播授權協議及我們所有的 FIGHT PASS 流媒體平台，觸及全球觀眾。我們內容的價值透過與 Paramount+ 及其他國際廣播機構的授權協議得以體現，而我們日益增長的消費者參與度則透過我們社交平台上的總追蹤者數量與互動情況得以證明。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，UFC 擁有超過 7 億名粉絲，這些粉絲年輕且多元，以及約 3.5 億名社交媒體追蹤者。

WWE，全球運動娛樂的領導者，透過各種渠道製作與發行獨特且創意的內容，包括與發行合作夥伴的內容版權協議，如 Netflix、ESPN、Versant 及 CW，為其週期性節目 Raw、SmackDown 及 NXT，以及 Premium Live Events 提供內容，透過社交媒體平台、現場活動及各種 WWE 主題消費者產品的授權進行 monetization。WWE 擁有超過 7 億名粉絲，以及約 4.9 億名社交媒體追蹤者，包括人才頁面。WWE 擁有超過 1.1 億名 YouTube 訂閱者，使其成為全球最受觀看的 YouTube 頻道之一，其全年節目在超過 10 億個家庭中以超過 20 種語言提供。

IMG 事業為全球領先的運動行銷公司，專門從事媒體權管理與銷售、多頻道內容製作與發行、品牌合作夥伴關係、策略諮詢、數位服務以及活動管理。其業務推動超過 300 個國際組織、協會、活動與球隊的收入、粉絲羣與智慧財產權成長，包括英格蘭超級聯賽、美國大聯盟、The R&A、溫布頓網球錦標賽、DP World Tour、ATP 與 WTA 巡迴賽、國家美式足球聯盟、CONMEBOL、歐洲籃球聯賽、沙特阿拉伯超級聯賽，以及其自有頻道 Sport 24。
On Location 為高階體驗式旅館業務，提供票務、客製化旅客體驗、現場活動製作與旅遊管理服務，涵蓋運動與娛樂領域。On Location 提供企業客戶與追求官方沉浸式體驗的球迷前所未有的接觸機會，包括 2024、2026 與 2028 年夏季與冬季奧運與帕運、國際足總世界盃 26、超級碗、NCAA 最終四強、WWE、UFC 等活動。
PBR 為全球首屈一指的公牛競技組織。目前，有超過 1,000 名公牛騎士參與 PBR Unleash The Beast 巡迴賽，每年舉辦超過 200 場活動，該巡迴賽囊括全球頂級公牛騎士；PBR Pendleton Whisky

Velocity Tour; the PBR Touring Pro Division; and international circuits in Australia, Brazil, and Canada. In addition, bull riders compete in the PBR Team Series, currently comprising 10 teams, as well as in the PBR Challenger Series, with more than 50 annual events nationwide. PBR Teams League and Unleash The Beast events are broadcast on CBS Television Network, with Teams League events also airing on the CW Network, for a combined reach of over 40 million viewers each year. Fans can also stream Unleash the Beast on Paramount+ and access the Teams League via FOX Nation, further extending PBR's reach into the digital space.

We believe our companies are well positioned for the future of media. We have the flexibility to deliver our content across channels to meet our fans where they are consuming media. Our multichannel distribution model enables TKO to capitalize on increased competition for premium live sports rights and sports entertainment programming across digital and linear services. We license our media rights under long-term contracts to leading distributors globally. The contractual, recurring nature of our revenue base provides our business with good visibility into revenue growth, which supports further investment in our products and adjacent content reinforcing the value of our properties to our fans and partners.

We generate revenue from the licensing of our live events and original programming to domestic and international broadcasters and distributors that carry our programming on digital and linear channels and via pay-per-view ("PPV"). Original programming includes long and short-form content, reality series and other filmed entertainment. Through the acquisition of IMG as part of the Endeavor Asset Acquisition on February 28, 2025, we also generate revenue by acting as a global distributor of sports programming, negotiating and selling media rights on behalf of rights holders, and providing content production and distribution services across a broad range of sports and live events.

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度報告中所載之經審計合併財務報表及相關附註資訊一併閱讀。

2025年2月28日，TKO OpCo，一家特拉華州有限責任公司，與TKO，一家特拉華州公司（合稱「TKO當事人」），完成Endeavor資產收購，取得IMG業務，包括某些以IMG品牌運作的業務、On Location以及專業公牛競技（"PBR"）（合稱「收購業務」），依據2024年10月23日簽訂的交易協議（經後續修訂，稱為「Endeavor資產收購協議」），由TKO當事人、Endeavor OpCo、IMG Worldwide, LLC，一家特拉華州有限責任公司（"IMG Worldwide"及與Endeavor OpCo合稱「EGH當事人」），以及Trans World International, LLC，一家特拉華州有限責任公司且為EGH之子公司（"TWI"）所簽訂。
以下討論的歷史財務資料反映我們的歷史營運成果與財務狀況，包含收購業務的歷史營運成果與財務狀況，該收購業務於2025年2月28日透過共同控制收購取得；請參閱我們於2025年2月28日及2025年5月8日提交的Form 8-K，以取得更多細節。以下討論中包含的歷史財務資料反映我們的歷史營運成果與財務狀況，並與TKO交易完成前的期間相關。
本討論包含基於管理階層目前計畫、預期與信念的展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預期的有重大差異，原因包括各種已知與未知因素，包括於本年度報告第一部分第1A項「風險因素」及本年度報告其他部分所列述的那些因素。
以下為我們2025年12月31日財年與2024年12月31日財年營運成果的討論與分析，並進行比較。2024年12月31日財年與2023年12月31日財年營運成果的討論與分析，請參閱Exhibit 99.1，標題為「第7項 管理階層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」，於2024年12月31日財年提交之Form 8-K現行報告中，於2025年5月8日提交至SEC。
TKO為一家高階運動與娛樂公司，經營領先的格鬥運動與運動娛樂公司。本公司透過四大主要活動來實現其品牌價值：(i) 媒體權利、製作與內容，(ii) 現場活動與豪華住宿，(iii) 合作夥伴關係與行銷，以及(iv) 消費者產品授權。

TKO透過Zuffa Parent, LLC（現稱TKO Operating Company, LLC）與World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc.（現稱World Wrestling Entertainment, LLC）（"WWE"）的組合成立，Zuffa Parent, LLC擁有並營運Ultimate Fighting Championship（"UFC"），一家備受推崇的格鬥運動品牌，以及World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc.（"WWE"），一家知名運動娛樂業務（"TKO交易"）。TKO交易將兩種互補的運動與運動娛樂業務結合於一家公司。有關TKO交易條款的更多資訊，請參閱本年度報告中所載經審計合併財務報表的附註4，即WWE的收購事項。
根據Endeavor資產收購協議，TKO當事人以總計約32.5億美元加上5,000萬美元的購股款調整（基於2024年10月23日結束的25個交易日中TKO Class A普通股的體積加權平均銷售價格）取得收購業務。EGH當事人則取得約2,654萬股TKO OpCo普通單位，並購入相應數量的TKO Class B普通股股份。
就取得業務在完成Endeavor資產收購前的歷史財務資料而言，該歷史財務資料係根據美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）自Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.的合併財務報表及會計記錄中取得，並以獨立財務報表方式編製，可能無法反映若取得業務為獨立營運公司時的財務狀況，亦不必然反映取得業務未來的財務資料。

就本公司歷史合併資產負債表而言，其包含Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.合併資產負債中可明確辨識或歸屬於取得業務的部分，包括與取得業務相關之子公司及/或合資企業，而Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.對這些子公司及/或合資企業擁有控制性財務權益。取得業務的資產、負債、營業收入及費用已根據Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.合併財務報表中所包含的歷史會計政策，以歷史成本基礎反映於這些合併財務報表中。EGH於公司層級持有的現金及現金等價物，因Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.對現金管理採取集中化作法，且其營運資金來自於此，故於任一呈列期間均不歸屬於取得業務。僅有取得業務擁有法律所有權的實體所持有的現金金額，反映於合併資產負債表中。現金的轉移，無論是至或自Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.集中化現金管理系統，均反映於合併資產負債表中之淨母公司投資項目，並反映於配合調整後期間至2023年9月12日TKO成立前的合併現金流量表之融資活動中。Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.於合併基礎上的債務，因Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.的借款並非取得業務的法律義務，故於任一呈列期間均不歸屬於取得業務。

就本公司歷史合併財務報表而言，其包含所有直接歸屬於取得業務的收入及費用，並反映部分Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc.的公司層級、基礎設施及共享服務費用的分攤，包括集中化研究、法律、人力資源、薪資、財務及會計、員工福利、不動產、保險、資訊科技、電信業者、財務及其它費用。在可行的情況下，這些費用已根據直接使用情況進行分攤，剩餘部分則根據員工人數及毛利率的比率或其他被認為能合理反映取得業務在呈列期間內所使用服務或所獲得利益的分攤方法進行分攤。然而，這些分攤可能無法反映取得業務作為獨立公司時在呈列期間內所應產生的費用。這些費用亦可能無法反映取得業務未來將產生的費用，或若取得業務從第三方取得這些服務時所產生的費用。
因此，如上所述，本財務狀況與營運成果分析中所呈現的歷史財務資料，包含TKO及取得業務在所有呈列期間的合併歷史財務資料。
截至2025年12月31日，本公司以三個應報告分部營運業務，即UFC、WWE及IMG。此外，本公司亦報告"公司及其它"組別的結果，該組別產生的收入及費用未歸屬於各業務分部。請參閱本年度報告其他處所附的經審計合併財務報表中的第19項附註，即"分部資訊"。
UFC分部反映UFC的業務運作。我們UFC分部的收入主要來自於其節目內容分發所產生的媒體權利費用；全球現場活動的門票銷售及場地費用；合作夥伴及行銷費用；以及UFC品牌產品的消費者產品授權協議。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們可能無法適應或管理新的內容分發平台或因新技術而產生的消費者行為變化。
我們可能無法實現Endeavor資產收購預期的效益。
由於我們的成功在很大程度上取決於維持專業聲譽的能力，有關我們或我們關鍵人員的負面宣傳可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們依賴高階管理階層及其他關鍵員工的持續服務。這些人員的流失或表現下降可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
公眾及消費者品味與偏好以及產業趨勢的變化可能會降低我們內容產品的 demand，並對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們的業務及營運成果可能受待決及未來訴訟、調查、聲請及其它爭議結果的影響。
全球大流行或其它健康危機的影響可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司關鍵人員、運動員及表演者可能因移民限制及相關因素而受到不利影響。
本公司若無法持續建立及維護娛樂資產，可能對營運成果造成不利影響。
未經授權揭露敏感或機密客戶資訊，可能損害本公司業務及與客戶的關係。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的A類普通股涉及重大風險。您應仔細考慮下列因素，並與本年度報告中包含的所有其他資訊一併考量，包括於「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」標題下以及本年度報告其他地方所包含的合併財務報表及相關附註，再決定是否投資本公司的A類普通股。我們在下文中所描述的任何風險因素都可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生不利影響。如果其中一個或多個風險或不確定性發展為實際事件，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，導致您損失全部或部分投資。本公司無法保證下列所討論的任何事件不會發生。請同時參閱「前瞻性陳述」以取得更多資訊。
我們從企業活動（如企業贊助與廣告）的自願性與企業性開支中產生收入的能力，受到許多因素影響，包括許多因素超出我們的控制範圍，例如總體經濟條件。

我們的業務依賴於自願性消費者與企業開支。與企業開支及自願性消費者開支相關的許多因素，包括影響可支配消費者收入的經濟條件，例如失業率、燃料價格、利率、稅率變動、影響企業或個人的稅法，以及通貨膨脹，都可能顯著影響我們的營運結果。雖然消費者與企業開支可能因超出我們控制範圍的原因而在任何時間下降，但與我們業務相關的風險在經濟放緩或衰退時期會變得更加嚴重，這可能伴隨企業贊助與廣告減少、現場活動參與人數減少，以及消費者在商品上的開支減少，等等。無法保證消費者與企業開支不會因經濟與地緣政治條件，或未來經濟條件惡化而受到不利影響，這可能會影響我們的營運結果與成長。一段時間的消費者或企業開支減少，例如在COVID-19疫情期間所發生的，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生不利影響。
我們依賴與電視與有線電視網、衛星供應商、數位串流合作夥伴及其他分銷合作夥伴的關鍵關係。如果我們無法維持、續約或取代這些關鍵協議，可能會影響我們分銷媒體內容，以及其他商品與服務的能力，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
我們成功的一個關鍵零組件是與電視與有線電視網、衛星供應商、數位串流及其他分銷合作夥伴的關係。我們依賴維持這些現有關係並加以擴展，以建立一個強大的網路，讓我們能安排多媒體權利銷售，包括我們活動與媒體內容的分銷。我們活動的電視節目由電視與有線電視網、衛星供應商、付費觀看（"PPV"）、數位串流及其他媒體分銷。

因為我們的收入有相當大一部分是直接或間接來自我們活動的分銷，因此任何未能維持或續約與分銷商與平台的協議，分銷商或平台未能繼續為我們提供服務，或未能在有利於我們的條件下進入新的分銷機會，都可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。我們定期與美國及海外的電信業者進行談判，以達成有關我們內容分銷的大量協議。我們與全球多個PPV供應商有協議，並透過PPV分銷我們的部分活動，包括某些僅透過PPV銷售的活動。我們與（i）Paramount有重要關係，作為所有UFC數字活動與UFC Fight Nights在美國與拉丁美洲的獨家分銷商，以及UFC Fight Nights在澳洲的獨家分銷商，以及Zuffa Boxing在美國的獨家分銷商與某些PBR節目分銷商，（ii）ESPN作為所有WWE PLE在美國的獨家分銷商，（iii）Netflix作為WWE RAW的獨家全球平台（以及在權利可於全球取得時，分銷所有WWE內容於美國以外地區，包括高級現場活動）及其他WWE庫存內容的獨家分銷商，（iv）USA Network作為SmackDown在美國的獨家分銷商，（v）The CW，其在有線電視網站上播放NXT，以及（vi）Peacock作為WWE Saturday Night's Main Event在美國的獨家分銷商。我們與Netflix關於WWE的協議有初始10年期限，Netflix有選擇權可延長10年，並在初始5年後選擇退出。如果我們未能維持與Netflix的協議，包括Netflix行使選擇退出權，可能會影響我們分銷WWE內容的能力，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
